definition.name: Draw Pavement Edges
definition.description: Create a sketch plane "B2_Pavement" at absolute Z -7150 mm, a line style "B2_Pavement Edge" (weight 3, grey 128/128/128), and draw 623 model lines and arcs for the 69 Basement 2 pavement edge items from basement2_pavement.json. Nothing existing is changed.
